run_chroma_inpainting: run the ChromaInpaintPipeline to inpaint masked regions of an image using a text prompt
encode_prompt_chroma: encode a text prompt into T5 prompt embeddings and attention masks for the Chroma pipeline
prepare_latents_chroma: prepare noisy latents from an input image by encoding, scaling noise, and packing for Chroma
prepare_mask_latents_chroma: prepare mask and masked-image latents by encoding, resizing, and packing for the Chroma transformer
calculate_shift_chroma: calculate the linear shift mu for the scheduler based on image sequence length and base max parameters
